summary: Iteration 9 frontend fixes validated on 390x844 mobile viewport. All 4 primary items PASS: (1) RUNWAY WIND card is fully within viewport (rwy-inc right edge=361 < 390). (2) Tab bar renders with all 5 tabs (WX/INFLIGHT/SEARCH/SAVED/SETUP) tappable; useSafeAreaInsets correctly wired in (tabs)/_layout.tsx. (3) auto-detect-badge no longer overlaps compass rose (badge bottom=135, compass top=163, 28px gap) and is positioned below START FLIGHT button (14px gap). (4) 'use-gps-button' present in dashboard header between location label and ROUTE button, is tappable. Regressions: dashboard loads with wttr.in fallback data, wind rose renders, hourly strip renders, ROUTE/fav buttons work.

issues: Compass 'S' label overlaps the numeric heading readout '000°' underneath; the four compass ring labels (N/E/S/W) are clipped by the fixed 260x260 SVG frame and sit on top of the metric labels row (visible as 'A' overlapping ALTITUDE and 'N' near GROUND SPEED). Pre-existing, not part of iter9 fixes but worth flagging.

react_native_issues.issue: Browser console reports 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' during login screen render. Non-blocking, but should be migrated. Likely originates from a third-party or Pressable-related wrapper; search codebase for pointerEvents prop usage.

action_items: None required for iter9 fixes — all 4 items validated and passing.

Note (not iter9): The auto_detect_flight preference for demo@test.com was persisted as false from prior test runs, so the badge only appeared after re-enabling in SETUP. New users will see the badge by default (server default is true).

Follow-up polish (optional): Compass rose labels overlap the heading text and the metric labels immediately below on 390px width. Consider adding more vertical padding under CompassRose or shrinking size to 240 on narrow screens.
Follow-up polish (optional): Address 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' console warning by migrating to style.pointerEvents.

(tabs)/_layout.tsx correctly imports and uses useSafeAreaInsets; height=60+insets.bottom, paddingBottom=8+insets.bottom.
inflight.tsx: recordWrap has marginBottom equivalent via spacing.lg — visually verified 28px gap between badge and compass.
dashboard.tsx: use-gps-button correctly calls Location.getForegroundPermissionsAsync then requestForegroundPermissionsAsync if not granted, then reloads via initGPS.
